knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}

twilight_dir <- "<PROJECT_ROOT>/Results/TWILIGHT_ANALYSIS_IQTREE_FASTBAPS/"

list.files(twilight_dir, recursive = F)
```


```{r}
clf <- read_tsv(paste0(twilight_dir, "classification.tab"))
genes_per_isolates <- read_tsv(paste0(twilight_dir, "genes_per_isolate.tab"))
```


```{r}
genes_per_isolates %>% 
  filter(! class %in% c("Absent in large lineages")) %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x = cluster, y = count, group = cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  facet_wrap(~ class, scales = "free") + 
  xlab("Cluster of RSSC population") +
  ylab("Gene family counts in class")



```


```{r}
genes_per_isolates %>% 
  filter(class == "Multi-lineage core") %>% 
  group_by(class, cluster) %>%
  summarise(median_class_count = median(count))


genes_per_isolates %>% 
  filter(class == "Lineage specific core")
```
